mdn_joint_layer_num.Description: Layer number for joint pose prediction in the feature pyramid network neck. Each layer increasingly downsamples the image by a factor of 2, with the 0th layer predicting at 1/4th the scale and the 3rd layer predicting at scale 1/(4*2^3) = 1/32.

predict_occluded.Description: Should we train the pose network to also predict whether keypoints are labeled as 'occluded' or not? Recall that you can label a point as 'occluded' or not. It may be helpful in your downstream task to know whether a keypoint is occluded, and this predicted category could be used for that.

pretrain_freeze_bnorm.Description: Freeze batch norm weights of the backbone to the pretrained weights

mdn_backbone.Description: Backbone network to use for GRONe. Available options are resnet50, hrnet, vit, convnext, swin, hrformer

mdn_base_lr.Description: Base learning rate for training. This learning rate is multiplied by learning rate multiplier. This might get displayed as 0. The default value is 0.0001
